name: Anomalous sound detection autoencoder (fan, int8)
description: 기계(팬) 소리 10초 클립의 이상 여부 판정. DCASE 2023 Task 2 베이스라인 구조의 오토인코더로, 보드가 클립의 log-mel 벡터 32개를 재구성한 오차(MSE)를 이상 점수로 낸다. 비상업 데이터(CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) 사용.

preprocessing.where: host (PC / server); the board has no microphone
preprocessing.vectors: 5 consecutive frames concatenated -> 640 dims; 309 vectors per 10 s clip
preprocessing.board_input: 32 evenly spaced vectors (np.linspace(0, 308, 32).round()) -> standardized with the training mean/std -> int8
preprocessing.score: model output = mean((x - AE(x))^2) over the K x 640 standardized values (dequantized)
preprocessing.decision: anomaly if score >= task_param (gamma fit (floc=0) on the float scores of 1000 normal training clips (K vectors), 90% point)

source.model: trained in this repository; architecture of the DCASE 2023 Task 2 autoencoder baseline (640-128x4-8-128x4-640, BatchNorm + ReLU)
source.license: repository license (model weights); see dataset for the samples

dataset.name: DCASE 2023 Challenge Task 2 Development Dataset, machine type fan (MIMII DG)
dataset.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (dataset 'Condition of use', Hitachi, Ltd. and NTT Corporation). NOTE: Zenodo metadata says CC BY 4.0; the dataset's own text says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, which we follow
citation: N. Harada, D. Niizumi, Y. Ohishi, D. Takeuchi, M. Yasuda. First-shot anomaly detection for machine condition monitoring: A domain generalization baseline. arXiv:2303.00455, 2023.

K. Dohi, T. Nishida, H. Purohit, R. Tanabe, T. Endo, M. Yamamoto, Y. Nikaido, Y. Kawaguchi. MIMII DG: sound dataset for malfunctioning industrial machine investigation and inspection for domain generalization task. DCASE 2022 Workshop, 31-35.

N. Harada, D. Niizumi, D. Takeuchi, Y. Ohishi, M. Yasuda, S. Saito. ToyADMOS2: another dataset of miniature-machine operating sounds for anomalous sound detection under domain shift conditions. DCASE 2021 Workshop, 1-5.
dataset.notes: package eval/demo samples and test_data.npz are features of these clips: derived data under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial, share-alike)
